names.en: J-source character withdrawn from CJK C1

title: The J-source character dropped from the CJK C1 candidate
scope: The single J-source character that IRGN1198 asks to drop from the CJK C1 v6 candidate. The document prints the C1 v6 number 08772 and the J source JMK65904 in prose and prints no glyph for the dropped character. The two glyph images on page 2 show the idiom 僥倖, not a per-record stencil. No published Unicode scalar is claimed.

documents.title: Proposition to drop one Japan's character from C1 candidate
documents.status: Asks the IRG to drop JMK65904 (C1 no. 08772) because it has no lone usage. The cover prints “N 1198”; IRGN1198 comes from the IRG document filename. No published scalar is claimed.

records.status: C1 v6 number 08772 and J source JMK65904, printed in the proposal's prose on page 2. The document asks to drop this character from the CJK C1 candidate; the two glyphs beside the idiom 僥倖 do not identify which one is JMK65904.
